IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Thursday 12 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 20 knots, reaching up to 25 knots inshore in the evening.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres inshore by early evening.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.

Friday 13 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots near Cape Bruny early in the morning. Winds becoming variable about 10 knots in the middle of the day.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing below 1 metre during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 3 metres offshore.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Saturday 14 November
Winds: West to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots becoming westerly 20 to 30 knots in the late afternoon then decreasing to 20 to 25 knots in the late evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres around midday.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Sunday 15 November
Winds: Westerly 20 to 25 knots turning southwesterly 20 to 30 knots during the morning.
Seas: 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2.5 to 3 metres, increasing to 3 to 4 metres during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail.
